skirmish.module.talisman_badges.name: Item Badges
skirmish.module.talisman_badges.descript: Labels on inventory and hotbar slots for HolyWorld items: sphere and talisman effects ("D3 A2"), rune, backpack level, TNT type (A, B, C4, BW, B2…). Read from the item's own name and lore.
Effects in short: D damage, A armour, S speed, AS attack speed, HP health, H haste
Top right: IM Immortality, RS Restoration
Type: A, B, C4, BW blast wave, B2, St stealer, RSt reliable stealer, IW ice wave
Badges on the hotbar too, not only in inventories
How much larger than a normal badge
